exemptions.reason: A CI gate that reads the repository's own registry and scripts (npm run check:orphan-matrix); it runs in the repository, ships nothing in the npm package and changes no command a user runs.

exemptions.changelog: CI: the plugin settings may not claim
exemptions.reason: A CI gate over .claude-plugin/ in the repository (npm run check:plugin-manifest); those files and the script are not part of the npm package, so no installed command shows it.

exemptions.changelog: Beta acceptance: one program runs the acceptance steps
exemptions.reason: Maintainer tooling under scripts/beta-acceptance/, started from a clone of the repository; it is not part of the npm package and adds no command to the installed uds. Its own behaviour is tested by cli/tests/e2e/xspec-469-r2-acceptance-run.test.js and xspec-469-r3-manual-items.test.js.

exemptions.changelog: CI: every [Unreleased] entry needs an acceptance step
exemptions.reason: A CI job and a generator for docs/PRE-RELEASE.md in the repository; nothing of it is in the npm package or visible in an installed command. Tested by xspec-469-r1-changelog-coverage.test.js and xspec-469-r5-pre-release-doc.test.js.

exemptions.changelog: CI: the end-to-end tests run on ubuntu, windows and macos
exemptions.reason: A change to .github/workflows/ci.yml and a helper script in the repository; it changes what CI runs, not what an installed uds does. Tested as far as a test can reach it by xspec-469-r4-ci-matrix.test.js; the three real runs are only visible on GitHub.

exemptions.changelog: The plugin settings carried skill counts that were wrong
exemptions.reason: The wrong skill counts were in .claude-plugin/plugin.json, marketplace.json and README.md, which live in the repository and the Claude Code marketplace listing, not in the npm package; the CI gate above keeps them right.

exemptions.changelog: CI: every command, subcommand and option of the uds CLI needs an acceptance step
exemptions.reason: A CI job and a baseline file for the maintainers in the repository (scripts/beta-acceptance/check-cli-coverage.mjs); it adds no command or option to the installed uds and nothing of it is in the npm package. Tested by cli/tests/e2e/xspec-471-r2-cli-coverage.test.js and xspec-471-r3-effect-assertions.test.js.

The step lets git print to the person's own terminal (human.inherit) so the person can see whether the characters are readable; the program cannot read that output. The automatic step commit-warning-hook checks the same warning text with contains.

exemptions.changelog: CI: after a release is published, the acceptance steps run against
exemptions.reason: A GitHub workflow (.github/workflows/post-publish-acceptance.yml) and four maintainer programs under scripts/beta-acceptance/ that run in the repository or on GitHub; none is in the npm package and no installed command changes. Tested by cli/tests/e2e/xspec-471-r1-post-publish-acceptance.test.js; the three real runs are only visible on the Actions page after a publish.

Its only effect is to add the interactive questions for the standards format, the content mode and the methodology to the init wizard; uds init --yes skips the wizard, so no non-interactive run can show it. Needs a person at a terminal.
